name: Olive Garden Plain Penne Pasta (With Extra Virgin Olive Oil & Salt)
whyItWorks: White semolina penne pasta (or gluten-free rotini) boiled soft and tossed with pure olive oil and sea salt. Avoids tomato acid, garlic, onion, and dairy cream completely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Create Your Own Pasta: Penne (or Gluten-Free Rotini), cooked well-done, with NO sauce—just extra virgin olive oil and salt on the side.' Top with plain grilled chicken.
